privacy.seoDescription: Tinnova's Privacy and Data Protection Policy, in compliance with Brazil's LGPD.
privacy.title: Privacy and Data Protection Policy
privacy.lead: At Tinnova, we respect the privacy and value the trust placed in us by our clients. This policy describes how personal information is collected, used, stored, and protected in compliance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD).

topics.title: Data Collection
topics.body: We collect only the information necessary to provide our services effectively. This includes name, email address, phone number, and payment data collected during registration, purchase, or newsletter sign-up.

topics.title: Data Use
topics.body: Information is used to provide and improve services, process transactions, respond to inquiries, send relevant communications, and carry out administrative analysis.

topics.title: Data Protection
topics.body: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

topics.title: Data Subject Rights
topics.body: Under the LGPD, data subjects have the right to access, correct, port, delete, and limit the processing of their personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at {email}.

topics.title: Changes to This Policy
topics.body: Periodic updates will be communicated via the website or email.

privacy.dpoText: Their responsibilities include accepting complaints, providing clarification, and guiding employees on personal data protection practices. Contact: {email}.
privacy.giftsObjectiveText: Maintain integrity and impartiality in business relationships, avoiding conflicts of interest.
privacy.giftsDefinitionText: Gifts or giveaways are items, services, or benefits offered with no expectation of equivalent payment, including promotional products, hospitality, discounts, and special favors.
privacy.giftsLimitText: Employees may accept gifts whose value does not exceed 100 US dollars (or the local currency equivalent) per individual item.
privacy.giftsTransparencyText: Gifts must be reported to a supervisor or the ethics department for appropriateness review.
privacy.giftsExceptionsText: Items of symbolic value (pens, notepads with logos) may be accepted without notification when clearly insignificant.
privacy.giftsConsequencesText: Violations may result in disciplinary action ranging from a warning to dismissal, depending on severity.
privacy.codeTitle: See our Code of Conduct and Ethics
privacy.codeText: Download the full document with the conduct and ethics guidelines adopted by Tinnova.
privacy.codeCta: Download Code of Conduct and Ethics
